summary: Force 2D simulation — 3D engine still drifts nodes in z
description: Bug: pinning z to 0 is not enough. 3d-force-graph defaults to a 3-axis simulation, so nodes drift in depth again after a few ticks. The user still sees clusters popping forward/back (seasick). Call numDimensions(2) on the ForceGraph3D instance so the layout can only move in x and y.
scope: Call numDimensions(2) on the ForceGraph3D instance in viewer.js
constraints: Strict TDD: write the failing test first and run it before implementation.
Do not add a watcher or CLI unless this task explicitly requires it.
Do not add npm or a bundler.
